faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGIPT IT System and Network Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the IT System and Network Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./ B. Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology or BCA/B.Sc. (Computer Science/IT) along with relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IT System and Network Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of IT System and Network Assistant.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position is contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the RGIPT located?
faq.answer: The RGIPT is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section in this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
